<div class="hp-banner-text">
<div class="hp-banner-text1">Real Programmers</div>
<h1 class="jumbo-tagline">Don't Use Frameworks</h1>
<div class="hp-banner-text2">
				They write web applications through command-line straight to the server. Hats off to them. For the rest of us, Nette is a great help to our work.
			</div>
<div class="hp-banner-text3">
				Nette is a family of mature and stand-alone components for PHP 7. Ready to be smitten?
				Together, they create a framework that had been <a href="http://www.sitepoint.com/best-php-framework-2015-sitepoint-survey-results/">rated as the 3rd most popular in the world</a>.
				Our philosophy is to focus on productivity, best practices, and security.
			</div>
<a class="hp-banner-button" href="https://doc.nette.org/en/getting-started">GET STARTED</a>
</div>

<section class="features features--nette">
<div class="container">
<div class="features-content content content--dark">
<div class="row">
<div class="column-tp">
<h2>Over 10 Yrs of Development</h2>
<p>We have been developing Nette for over 10 years- and counting! Libraries we provide are therefore <b>highly mature, stable and widely used</b>. They are trusted by a number of global corporations and many significant websites rely on us. <a href="https://builtwith.nette.org">Who uses and trusts Nette?</a></p>
</div>
<div class="column-tp">
<h2>Security Is a Priority 🛡️</h2>
<p>There is nothing we care about more than security. That is why we had built Nette as the safest PHP framework. It had passed many audits with flying colours,
						it eliminates safety traps like XSS, CSRF and brings out <a href="https://latte.nette.org/en/guide#toc-context-aware-escaping">ground-breaking methods</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="column-tp">
<h2>Catching Bronze 🥉</h2>
<p>We aim to create Nette as a fun and easy to use framework, that programmers can fall in love with.  And we seem to be doing it well! We were rated as the 3rd most popular framework in a survey
						<a href="http://www.sitepoint.com/best-php-framework-2015-sitepoint-survey-results/">„Best PHP Framework for 2015“</a>
						by a well-know magazine SitePoint.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
<div class="column-tp">
<h2>Libraries &amp; Framework</h2>
<p>Nette consists of a number of handy standalone libraries, which can be used in any codebase, for example combined with WordPress or another framework.
						Careful, some of them are highly addictive! These are the components that Nette Framework is built on.
					</p>
</div>
<div class="column-tp">
<h2>Clean Code and Best Practises</h2>
<p>Thoughtful, high-quality, well-tested and pure object-oriented design using the new features in PHP 7.1. Nette will lead to well designed applications with emphasis on future extensibility. According to tests Nette Framework is one of the fastest frameworks ever.</p>
</div>
<div class="column-tp">
<h2>Active Community</h2>
<p>You don´t have to do it alone! Community around the framework gives <a href="https://forum.nette.org">advice</a>, creates continuously growing <a href="https://componette.com">collection of addons</a> for easy use in your applications and shares experience
				</p></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
